records.reviewer: Codex (owner-authorized AI author and reviewer; not independent)
records.review_state: Accepted as a bounded proposal-stage reader dossier; not an operating-outcome admission

sections.heading: An anchor-only denominator
sections.text: The retained baseline has zero broadband-serviceable location rows and 21 community-anchor-institution rows. These describe different units. A household subscription rate cannot be calculated from this record by dividing by zero, substituting the 21 anchors or borrowing locations from Triangle's Hill-1 project. The zero is a source inventory value; it is not an observed count of users, connected institutions or service outcomes.

sections.heading: Small financing does not imply completion
sections.text: The proposal records US$33,124 of BEAD support and US$11,042 in match. Their size does not establish that work is simple, complete or accepted. Any later reimbursement must retain the Hill-2 project ID and identify the work it covers. Comparing this proposal with a household-location project by dollars per row would conflate anchor service with residential service and omit actual scope and accepted expenditure.

sections.heading: Preserve absent technical coding
sections.text: The baseline's raw technology-code list is empty; it must remain empty until appropriate source evidence supplies the missing coding. The deployment row's project-type value C is retained separately and is not a substitute for a technology code. Hill-1 shares the operator UEI but is a different project. The lack of a tribal-land flag here is a property of this baseline, not a universal legal or geographic clearance.
